unverified text is now redacted by default (the script fails closed): a column that is not an identifier by name is kept only when every value is verified as a number that passes the numeric checks, a code of a closed grammar (ICD-9 and ICD-10, LOINC, ATC, HGVS, rsID, Ensembl, RefSeq, TNM, stage, grade, ECOG, blood group), a whole value of a closed vocabulary (sex and gender, yes and no, missing values, census race and ethnicity, result flags, laterality, response, smoking status, units, common words of scripts without capital letters; only missing values under a column name that names a person, a role, a relative, a contact or a place), a date reduced to the year, or a state or country under a state or country column; any other text (diagnoses, drugs, sites, arms and visits written as words, and names with any qualifier, in any script or case) is redacted and listed as needing the person's decision, and a column the person keeps with --keep is scrubbed for patterns only and named again in the output and the report for a spot-check; type, status and payer columns of identifier words (Insurance Type, Login Status, City Type) can be kept on request rather than refused; ages under age column names in other languages (Edad, Alter, Idade, 年龄, 年齢, 나이, Возраст, العمر) are grouped as 90+; a year and a month with no day (2021-03, 2021/03, 2021 Mar, 202103, 2021.03) keeps only the year under any column name and in kept text, while seasons such as 2010-11 stay in kept text, and numbers shaped like a month and a day with no separator (0314, 03142021) are redacted; state and country columns pass the residual check, which honours --keep for name and place shapes but never for patterns; long text in scripts without capital letters is free text; kept text loses handles, short URLs, user@host, SN serials, a day and a month after a date word, dates with month names in six other languages, handles after Instagram:, u/ and before #1234, and titled or labelled names in scripts without capital letters; numbers fail closed too: whole numbers of four or more digits, or with a leading zero, are kept only under a column name that names a measurement (a lab, a vital sign, a count, a score, a dose, a unit, money, a duration), so record numbers that repeat across visits in any written form (4527832, 00088221, 6135517.0, 4,527,832), ZIP codes that lost their leading zero, dates written as numbers (YYMMDD, 3262017) and Excel date serials are pseudonymized or redacted and listed for the person's decision, and whole numbers up to 125 with some over 89 under any other column name are grouped as ages; every date column writes [90_OR_OLDER] for a year 90 or more years before the reference year, and birth dates are read under abbreviated and other-language names (DoB, BDate, Geburtsdatum, fecha de nacimiento, 出生日期, 생년월일, Дата рождения); age column names are read in compounds and with any qualifier (Alter bei Diagnose, Patientenalter, Ålder vid diagnos, 年纪, 연세), ages in months or days and with the units y and mo are converted, and text in an age column is redacted; a column named for a relative, a household member or a contact or for the person's own first, last or given name in any script (Next Kin, Contact Person, Landlord, Lives With, 姓名, 이름) cannot be kept unless every value is a category word or a number; a column kept over a shape finding is reported as kept on the person's word (kept_unverified_columns), not as verified; a header row with an identifier pattern is refused, and a column name that looks like a value or a name is withheld and written as column_N; a file that is not UTF-8 is refused with the remedy, UTF-16 with a byte order mark is read, and --encoding reads any other; census race words and bare units count only under their own column names; round 3 of the review: column names fail closed too, so a column name is shown, reported and copied only when every word in it is a known column word and not only a common surname (a surname, a titled name or a name in any script read from a first row of data is withheld and written as column_N), --no-header reads a file without a header row, --keep-name and --keep-all-names show a name the person confirms, repeated header cells are refused by position, and --delimiter reads semicolon, pipe and tab files; numbers are judged cell by cell, so one record number, ZIP code, year, Excel serial or age from 90 to 125 changes a column whatever else it holds, numbers written with an exponent are pseudonymized and decimals with five or more digits before the point redacted under a column name that names no measurement, Excel serials are dates also under time and day names, and a measurement name ending in Case, Patient or Encounter is a record number's name; numeric days of the month, months and weekdays (Admit Day, Discharge Month, MM, Mois, 入院月, Weekday, or short columns beside their year) are redacted as date elements; a latitude or longitude alone is redacted, under coordinate words in any script by name; a type or status column of an identifier word, a column named for the person (Subject, Member, Donor) or a social network, and phone and postal code names in other languages (Telefon, PLZ, CEP) cannot be kept when they hold words that are not category words; ages with a unit of years in other languages (94 ans, 95 años, 95岁) are converted and Kor, Vanus and Amžius are age names; round 4 of the review: a column name holding a number of five or more digits, a decimal of four or more places or a year 90 or more years ago (Patient 3767393, Weight 94110, Weight 37.7749) is refused like an identifier pattern and never printed, and a first-row cell shaped like a code (S001) is withheld; --keep fails closed too, refused unless every word of the column name is a known column word, and for a column named for the person, a relative, a contact or another person in their life (Mom, Twin, ICE, Witness, Customer), an employer, a school, a home, an address, a device, an image or notes in any language, which the plan lists as columns that cannot be kept; names, addresses, telephones, email addresses, plates, national IDs, health cards, claims and record numbers named in other languages and scripts (AKA, Kana, Nama, Adresse, Calle, 住所, Courriel, Kennzeichen, DNI, CPF, OHIP, Prontuário, Patientennummer, 病历号) are identifiers by name, and a column named with a word for number or record holding numbers of four or more digits or codes is a record number that cannot be kept; a month or a day of a date written in a column of its own is redacted whatever the column is called (numbers from 1 to 12 or 1 to 31 covering most months or days, and in a file with a column of years any column of numbers from 1 to 31), and a day or a week of the year by name; coordinates are judged cell by cell, so one precise coordinate redacts a column; short study numbers under Study ID, Pat No or Case and repeated record numbers of seven or more digits under a measurement name are pseudonymized, decimal ages from 90 to 125 under ETA, Old or Year and comma-grouped months under an age name are grouped as 90+; round 5 of the review: a week (1 to 53) or a day of the year (1 to 366) is redacted as a date element whatever the column is called in a file with a year, where a date column counts as a year and any column of whole numbers that fits the range of a date part is redacted rather than kept or grouped as ages, and under a word for a week in any language (Week, Wk, Epi Wk, MMWR Week, Semana, Woche, 周) in any file; a column name is checked after its separators are removed, so a record number written in groups (Patient 376 7393, Pt 37_67_393, ID 12 34 56 78) is refused, and so is a date element finer than the year (Mar-19, WBC Feb-20, 03/14, 14/3, Q1 20, W12 2020), while a month name or a gene-like month code (Weight March, OCT4, Mar19) is withheld; code grammars take only their exact published shapes (Ensembl with eleven digits, RefSeq NM_, NR_, XM_, XR_, NP_, XP_ with six or nine, an rsID in lower case, ICD-10-CM in capitals with two digits, ICD-9 V and E codes in their ranges, an HGVS substitution of one base by another, LOINC only under a lab or test name), so prefixed record numbers (RS1234567, NM_1234567, H8Q.600, E456.8) are no longer kept as codes; --keep under a word for a person is accepted only for clinical and care staff (physicians, doctors, nurses, surgeons, clinicians, providers, attendings, residents, fellows, pharmacists, therapists, technicians, technologists, midwives and their abbreviations), never for any other person (Who, Case, Reporter, Author, Signer, Manager, Director, Officer, Agent, Rep, Kind, Tía, Deceased, Seen By); and smaller gaps: short surnames that are also column words are withheld alone, a fiscal year in a column name is a year, a public accession in a column name is shown once the person confirms it with --keep-name #N, repeated seven-digit record numbers are found in signed, decimal and exponent forms, a measurement name ending in a claim, policy, invoice, plan, visit or record word is not a measurement, a telephone number written as a decimal (555.0134) is redacted, Post Code, ZCTA and PIN Code are ZIP code names, and Y.O. is an age name; round 6 of the review: --keep is refused on the set of a column name's words, so a word for someone other than clinical or care staff anywhere in the name beside a part of a name or a word that says nothing else (Patient Last, Mother First, MotherLast, pat_last, Pat Info, Kin Ref, In-law), an abbreviation of a name (PatNm, PNm, FNm, LNm, Donor_Nm), a place that is not a place of care (Home Area, Lives, Living, Community, Catchment Area, Service Area, Area, Locale, Territory, Place, Venue, Ort) and a record word (Cartella, Dossier) refuse it when a value is a word; numbers of five or more digits in any written form are kept on the person's word only under a column name that names a measurement or the number of a thing (Gene ID, Position, Lot No, CPT), so Value, Code1, Registration, Token or VID of record numbers cannot be kept; health and patient numbers by abbreviation (PHN, NHS, NHI, NIP, PRN, PID, Patid), a key, a reference or a token of the patient (Patient Ref, Patient Key) and a name with a number sign (Pat#, MR#) are record numbers by name; under a column name that names no measurement, decimals of two or more places within 180 that reach 10, negative decimals from -60 to -180 and decimals within 90 beside a coordinate are possible coordinates (Value, X, Y, Loc X, Pos, Point, Geo1, Index), and so is a pair of two-place columns; repeated six-digit numbers under Visits, Encounters or Admissions are record numbers; a number of thousands of digits no longer stops the run; the plan says when every unverified value of a column is shaped like a name or a place, and names the remedy for a wide matrix named by probes; round 7 of the review: numbers fail closed by name, as unverified text does, so a column of numbers is kept by default only under a column name that names a measurement (a lab analyte, a vital sign, a score or a scale, a dose, a count, a duration, money, a statistic, or a unit in the name or beside the number) and only when its numbers pass the identifier and date checks, and years only under a name for a year, while numbers under any other name (Value, Result, Col3, X, Y, Index, Point, Pos, Visit Number) are redacted and listed for the person's decision with a plan line saying the script cannot verify that they are not identifiers, dates or coordinates, which also closes one-decimal coordinate pairs under neutral names; dates written as numbers are dates under any column name (a decimal year, a year and a week or a day, a decimal birth year, a Unix timestamp of 10 or 13 digits with fractional seconds or negative, a 7-digit Julian date), reduced to the year or [90_OR_OLDER]; under a name that does not say age a column with a possible age over 89 is redacted rather than grouped; a header cell holding a NUL, a control or a format character (a zero-width space, a direction mark) is refused by its position, a file with NULs in its first bytes is refused as UTF-16 without a byte order mark with the remedy, and a name spelled out letter by letter is withheld; --keep, --redact and --keep-name take a range of positions (#2-#501) for a wide matrix; and smaller gaps: a dotted ICD-10 shape with a hemisphere letter and three or four digits (N37.7749) is a code only under a diagnosis name, two capital letters (initials) count as vocabulary only when all come from one list, --keep is refused for Signed, Salutation, MI, To, From, Hx Source, Map, Geo Location, Shelter, Building, Block, Origin and a name word spelled with digits (Patient N4me), short numbers under Pt Code, Participant Label or Patient Seq are pseudonymized, >99 under a word for old age is an age, a long cell of slashes no longer takes quadratic time, and Bill and Charity alone are withheld as column names; round 8 of the review: cells and column names share one definition of a date, read after the script folds full-width and other scripts' digits and drops accents, so a column name holding a date of two or more elements in any script or calendar the cells are read in (2019年3月14日, 3月14日, 2019년 3월 14일, 14 tháng 3 năm 2019, 14 Mac 2019, 14 марта 2019, R1.5.1, 令和元年5月1日, 14 มีนาคม 2562) or a month and a day as two numbers with one over 12 (31-12, 14-3, WBC 3-19) is refused, and one holding a month or a day alone (3月, 3월, tháng 3, 14日), a word for a day and one for a month with numbers (Day 14 Month 3), two numbers of 12 or less (WBC 3-4), a decimal or four digits that read as a day and a month (WBC 14.3, WBC 1231), a person word beside a word that can be a surname (Patient White, Dr Ward) or two name words side by side is withheld; such dates in kept text and in date columns become the Gregorian year (Buddhist and Japanese-era years converted) or [DATE]; repeated seven-digit numbers under a measurement name are pseudonymized whatever their share, Label, Pseudonym, Lot, Batch and a number sign beside a measurement word make it a number's name, six or more digits under a time name are a date or a clock time, and numbers of five or more digits under a name that names only a unit of length (X (m)) are possible grid coordinates; a zero-width joiner or non-joiner and a direction mark are accepted in a name of a script without capital letters, and --number-duplicates gives a repeated column name its position; round 9 of the review: column names fail closed by token, so a name is split on every separator, on camel case and where letters meet digits and is shown only when every token is a column word, a unit, a closed lab or code abbreviation or a number allowed where it stands (an ordinal under 100 after a word, a range or a scale, an amount before a unit, a threshold after a comparator, a recent year), otherwise withheld as column_N, and the date, age, coordinate, record number and identifier detectors read every separator-normalised form of a name, so a month and a day, an age over 89 or a coordinate joined by an underscore, a dot, a pipe, a comma or brackets (WBC_03_14, Visit 14 03, Age_102, Edad 95, Lat_37.77, Loc 37.77 -122.45) is refused like its slash form and a refusal names the positions; cells and column names read Roman-numeral months (14.III.2019, III/2019) and month abbreviations of every language the dates are read in, with two-digit years (14-Paź-19, 14Úno2019, Mrt-19); a wide matrix (V1 to V2000, Gene1000, Feature_00001, cg probes) is confirmed as a group with a range or a pattern (--keep-name 'Gene*'), never under a prefix that names a person, a record or a sample; under a measurement name every cell is checked, so one whole number of five or more digits, one Excel serial with a time, one decimal of four or more places from 1 to 180 or one age over 89 with a unit puts the column under the person's decision, with large numbers trusted only under money, small units of time, quantities counted in thousands and distances when they do not repeat as record numbers do, and the plan line, the report note and SKILL.md say exactly what is checked; a column named for notes, comments or remarks is redacted whatever it holds and listed among the columns that cannot be kept; a column of years kept with --keep keeps the 90-year cap; Pa is a person word under --keep, and Gender Identity, Sexual Orientation, Pronouns, Species, Financial Class, Advance Directive, Causality, Assessment, Reagent and Contraception can be kept
